story.letter:
Dear friends,

Thimble Hollow Campground has been closed for nine autumns now. The pitches are grown over and the fire ring is cold, but the valley is as pretty as it ever was.

I'm getting too old to keep it up on my own, and I'd sooner hand the keys to somebody who'll love it. If you two want it, it's yours. Come up the old road. I'll be waiting by the fire.

Yours truly,
Ranger $ranger

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.about: A felt rabbit with a cotton-ball tail. Rabbits nibble the meadow from breakfast to bedtime and hop off if you rush them.
rabbit.clue: hops round the meadow all day

squirrel.name: Squirrel
squirrel.about: A busy red squirrel who keeps a pantry in every tree and forgets half of it. That's how new trees start.
squirrel.clue: by the big trees east of the fire, all day

deer.name: Deer
deer.about: A shy deer who comes to the edge of the woods when the light is low. Walk slowly and she may stay for a photo.
deer.clue: at the west woods at dawn and dusk, from day 2

bear.name: Bear
bear.about: A big, gentle bear who likes to sit by the fire of an evening. He has never once eaten a camper.
bear.clue: sits by the fire in the evening, from day 3

axe.name: Axe

axe.clue: take a swing at a tree

rod.clue: cast a line at the pond

camera.clue: take a photo of an animal

shovel.name: Shovel

water_point.name: Water point

lantern_post.name: Lantern post

grilled_trout.name: Grilled trout

grilled_sunfish.name: Grilled sunfish

board.ask_1: Morning! First things first: guests need to know where to book. That camp board in your kit goes up anywhere you like.
board.ask_2: Pick it in build mode and set it down somewhere folk can find it. Bookings will show up on it.
board.thanks: There she stands! The first booking won't be long now. Here, a few coins for the trouble.

pitch.ask_1: Next, a guest needs somewhere to sleep. Mark out a tent pitch, a nice flat spot near the fire.
pitch.ask_2: A pitch costs a few coins to put down, and you get them all back if you ever pack it away.
pitch.thanks: A proper pitch! That's the first one in nine years. Walk-in guests will find it now.

guest.ask_1: Guests are coming! Each one wishes for something. You'll see it float over their head.
guest.ask_2: Bring a guest what they wish for. That's what makes a stay worth telling friends about.
guest.thanks: Did you see that smile? That's the whole job, right there. They'll be back, mark my words.

bench.goal: Build a bench by the fire
bench.ask_1: A fire wants something to sit on. Make a log bench at the workbench and set it by the fire.
bench.thanks: Now that's a fine seat. Guests sit a while longer when there's a bench to sit on.

supper.ask_1: Let's have supper the old way. The pond's full of perch if you're patient with a rod.
supper.ask_2: Catch one, then grill it over the fire. A grilled fish makes any guest's evening.
supper.thanks: Smells wonderful! Grilled fish by the fire, just like the old days.

replant.goal: Plant a sapling where a tree was cut
replant.ask_1: We've taken some wood from the woods. Time to give some back. Dig up a sapling and plant it on a stump.
replant.thanks: There. In a few days that'll be a tree again. The woods remember who looks after them.

star.ask_1: You've done everything I've asked, and done it well. Now the camp needs a reputation.
star.ask_2: Happy guests, a few comforts, a tidy camp. Earn a second star and I'll have news for you.
star.thanks_1: Two stars! Word's getting round the valley, I can tell you that.
star.thanks_2: I've nothing more to ask. It's your camp now. Keep it growing, and I'll keep an eye out for Lantern Night.

ranger.hello: Well now, there you both are! I'm Ranger $ranger. I looked after this place for thirty-odd years.
ranger.closed: Thimble Hollow's been shut nine autumns. The pitches are grown over, and nobody has sat by this fire in all that time.
ranger.fire_ask: Let's fix that before dark. The fire needs %s. Sticks lie about the edge of the woods, and the trees give wood.
ranger.fire_lit: Look at that! The first fire at Thimble Hollow in nine years. Smells like home.
ranger.lantern_night: Back in my day the whole valley came up for Lantern Night at the end of the year. Bring the camp up to five stars and we'll light the lanterns again. I'd like to see that once more.
ranger.name_ask: Now, a camp needs a name, and it's yours to give. What shall we paint on the sign?
ranger.clipboard: Here, take my old clipboard. Everything there is to do is on it, and it ticks things off as you go. {clipboard} opens it.
ranger.good_night: Word will get round that the fire's lit, so expect guests. Rest in your tent whenever you're ready. I'll be right here by the path.
ranger.idle_1: Sticks and berries come back to the edge of the woods every morning. Never hurts to look.
ranger.idle_2: A guest who gets what they wished for tells their friends. That's how a camp fills up.
ranger.idle_3: Plant a sapling where you cut a tree. The woods give back what you give them.
ranger.idle_4: If the sign ever needs repainting, it's down by the path. Call the place whatever you like.
